PICKLERFRIGIL-GLISTENING_AMETHYST.descri: At the start of your turn, applies {HypothermiaPower:diff()} [gold]Hypothermia[/gold] to a random enemy.
PICKLERFRIGIL-GLISTENING_AMETHYST.flavor: Gems like these have a way of concentrating magical energies just the way you want.
PICKLERFRIGIL-GLISTENING_AMETHYST.title: Glistening Amethyst
PICKLERFRIGIL-RADIANT_BISMUTH.descriptio: At the start of your turn, applies {HypothermiaPower:diff()} [gold]Hypothermia[/gold] to a random enemy 4 times.
PICKLERFRIGIL-RADIANT_BISMUTH.flavor: Magnitudes harder to control, as if you really wanted to in the first place.
PICKLERFRIGIL-RADIANT_BISMUTH.title: Radiant Bismuth
PICKLERFRIGIL-EVERFROZEN_SPIKE.descripti: When Icy attacks deal unblocked damage, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Hypothermia[/gold]
PICKLERFRIGIL-EVERFROZEN_SPIKE.flavor: You could cast this unto a raging inferno, yet it never seems to melt.
PICKLERFRIGIL-EVERFROZEN_SPIKE.title: Everfrozen Spike
PICKLERFRIGIL-CRYSTALLIZED_SALT.descript: The first time you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Gemstone[/gold] each combat, its effect is repeated.
PICKLERFRIGIL-CRYSTALLIZED_SALT.flavor: Tastes like salt. I don't know what you expected.
PICKLERFRIGIL-CRYSTALLIZED_SALT.title: Crystallized Salt
PICKLERFRIGIL-SNOWGLOBE.description: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from playing a card each combat, apply half as much [gold]Hypothermia[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PICKLERFRIGIL-SNOWGLOBE.flavor: The more you shake it, the greater the storm.
PICKLERFRIGIL-SNOWGLOBE.title: Snowglobe
PICKLERFRIGIL-ROCKY_ROAD_SUNDAE.descript: For every [blue]4[/blue] cards [gold]Exhausted[/gold], your next attack deals [blue]3[/blue] additional damage.
PICKLERFRIGIL-ROCKY_ROAD_SUNDAE.flavor: A welcome treat for a warm kobold.
PICKLERFRIGIL-ROCKY_ROAD_SUNDAE.title: Rocky Road Sundae
PICKLERFRIGIL-DIAMOND_NEEDLE.flavor: It seems frivolous, but they're more common than you'd think.
PICKLERFRIGIL-DIAMOND_NEEDLE.title: Diamond Needle
PICKLERFRIGIL-RHINESTONE_SPECTACLES.desc: At the start of combat, create [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Gemstones[/gold] in your Discard Pile.
PICKLERFRIGIL-ICE_SKATES.description: When you draw a card during your turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Flow[/gold].
PICKLERFRIGIL-ICE_SKATES.title: Ice Skates
PICKLERFRIGIL-COLDSTEEL_SPEARHEAD.descri: the first time you [gold]Accumulate[/gold] each combat, [gold]Accumulate[/gold] twice as much.
PICKLERFRIGIL-COLDSTEEL_SPEARHEAD.flavor: What do you mean coldsteel isn't a real thing?
PICKLERFRIGIL-COLDSTEEL_SPEARHEAD.title: Coldsteel Spearhead
